name: Sunday Lore / 10k / Cubbon Park / NOV 15
description:
Sunday Lore: The Weekly Chapter (Invite Only)

POV: The morning air is sharp, the vibe is electric, and you're exactly where you need to be to kick off the week.

Welcome to Sunday Lore, our weekly ritual where the community matters more than the pace. This isn't just another workout; it’s our space to reset, reconnect, and write the next chapter of our journey together.

The Mission: New Beginnings

This week, we’re all about the "Day One." You know that person who’s been saying they’ll start running "eventually"? This is their formal invitation. Drag your roommate, your best friend, or that colleague out of bed, we’re making sure nobody runs alone.

What’s on the Menu?

  • Your First 10K : Expect a full hype squad to cheer you across the line.

  • Just the Vibes: As always, the energy is unmatched.

Who Are We?

We are Main Mission (the crew formerly known as Indiranagar Run Club). We believe the best miles are the ones shared with friends. Come for the run, stay for the community and yes, the post-run coffee is on us.

name: Main Mission \ Athlete's Couch \ 5k Run \ Open Mic

location.name: Brik Oven, Sarjapur
location.address: Brik Oven, Sarjapur, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

description:
Athlete's Couch

A morning to connect and geek out over running stories and training with other folks.

About the event

Calling every runner and athlete in Bangalore, whether you're chasing a personal best, training for your first race, or just love the long sunday runs.

And this isn't only for athletes. If you're thinking about starting your running journey, this is a good place to begin. Meet people who've been there, hear how they got started, and figure out what might work for you. Everyone is welcome.

We're bringing the community together for a relaxed morning of conversation, stories and good food at Brik Oven, Sarjapur. The morning starts with a community 5K run, followed by coffee and an open mic with Bangalore's running community, where people share their journeys, wins, setbacks and everything they've learned along the way. Then we head into breakfast over light music, with plenty of time to meet people.

Come to connect and geek out on everything running: shoes and gear, nutrition, recovery, training plans, race prep and more.

Schedule

• 7:00 AM: Community 5K run

• 8:00 AM: Coffee at Brik Oven, Sarjapur

• After the run: Open mic with the Bangalore running community

• 9:30 AM:Breakfast by Brik Oven

Your ticket includes

• Community 5K run

• Coffee

• Entry to the open mic

• Breakfast at Brik Oven

• A morning with Bangalore's fitness community!

Details

• Date: Saturday, 21 November 2026

• Time: 8:00 AM onwards at Brik Oven (community 5K run at 7:00 AM)

• Venue: Brik Oven, Sarjapur, Bangalore

• Ticket: ₹300 per person

• Hosted by: Brik Oven x Main Mission

Who should come

Everyone. Seasoned runners, weekend joggers, other athletes, and anyone who's curious about running but hasn't started yet. You don't need any running experience to join.
